language_target.server-default: Complete stable grammar, types, functions, aggregations, matching and time semantics; duration expressions enabled as in the server.
language_target.upstream-tests: Separate upstream builtin-test profile, including its explicit experimental parser and engine options.
language_target.qualification: Required features and expressions cannot be skipped or counted as passes when unsupported. A finite corpus is evidence, not proof for all possible inputs.

numerical_contract.algorithms: Use upstream algorithms and operation order.
numerical_contract.structure: Exact value kind, byte labels and strings, timestamps, sample types, series membership, error attribution and warning/info sets.
numerical_contract.ordering: Preserve captured traversal; require order explicitly for order-sensitive cases.
numerical_contract.numeric_fields: Pinned util/almost.Equal with epsilon 1e-6, including its near-zero and NaN rules. Histogram bucket boundaries are exact; equivalent zero-bucket packing follows Compact(0).
numerical_contract.discrete_results: Case authors must set exact_numeric for boolean or other discrete output checks. Test complete threshold, matching and ranking expressions.
numerical_contract.raw_bits: Report every paired binary64 difference even when accepted numerically; strict-bits is a separate diagnostic gate.

fixtures.times: Signed int64 milliseconds; explicit instant/range context, lookback and subquery step.
fixtures.bytes: Base64 JSON fields for label names/values, string values, query_bytes and diagnostic messages.
fixtures.numbers: Sixteen hexadecimal digits encode binary64 bits; no JSON-number conversion.
fixtures.inputs: Ordered series and strictly increasing mixed float/integer-histogram/float-histogram sample timelines, with optional start timestamps.
fixtures.outputs: Scalar, string, vector, matrix or error; complete float histograms, rows and diagnostics captured before query Close.
fixtures.boundary: Internal test interchange only. Production ABI, API and Cloud transport are separate contracts.

upstream_evaluation.current_status: Source inventory; complete typed DSL capture and Rust execution are required in the typed-core stage.

upstream_parser.current_status: Source inventory; computed inputs and structured expectations must be imported in the typed-core stage.

sre.current_status: Pinned private source closure and reference parsing. Controlled-input Rust evaluation of every expression, recording dependencies and issue 6028 shapes remains required.
